text: Welcome to this live Telegram AI Hub demonstration. Every chatbot response shown in this video was generated from a real Telegram conversation connected to an Odoo database. Only dedicated demonstration records are displayed.
For this demonstration, the assistant has created a contact named Demo Customer August 2026 and a CRM opportunity named Telegram AI Hub Demo Deal. Here, I enter a new request directly in Telegram.

The chatbot queries Odoo and returns the two records created during this live session. It displays the demonstration contact, email address, opportunity, linked contact, stage, expected revenue and probability.
This is real Odoo data retrieval, not a scripted chatbot answer. Each request is processed through approved Odoo tools and remains limited by the permissions assigned to the linked employee.

Employees can use natural English to ask about contacts, CRM, invoices, sales orders, products, stock, payments and appointments. Telegram voice requests are also supported when transcription is configured.
Administrators authorize each permanent Telegram numeric identity, link it to an internal Odoo user and explicitly select the business capabilities that person may use.

The Odoo dashboard monitors conversations, messages, authorized employees, success rates and errors. ResilientByte Maroc also provides assistance with installation and initial configuration. Contact us for a guided demo.
